title: Critique: the synthesis may be overly inclusive

statements.text: Ramstead and colleagues, Safron among them, describe IWMT as a synergistic and inclusive account that may be overly inclusive for ease of understanding, which makes it harder to say which of its many posits carry the explanation.

sources.quote: IWMT aims to provide a synergistic and inclusive (albeit possibly overly-inclusive with respect to ease-of-understanding) account
